# Production Readiness Checklist: SaaS Stabilization

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for the stabilization spec/plan — is production readiness
completely, clearly, and measurably specified before implementation?
**Created**: 2026-09-25
**Feature**: specs/004-saas-stabilization/spec.md

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are session-lifecycle requirements (regeneration on login, revocation on password
  change/deactivation) specified for all roles? [Completeness, Spec FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are staff permission requirements stated as an exhaustive allowlist (creation only)
  rather than a vague restriction? [Completeness, Spec FR-001b]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are retired-delivery-credential requirements defined (denied everywhere, no login or
  dashboard remains)? [Completeness, Spec D4]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are per-restaurant delivery-toggle requirements specified for both the admin setting
  and customer visibility? [Completeness, Spec FR-003b]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are safe-error requirements defined for all failure classes (no secrets, tokens, or
  internals in responses)? [Completeness, Spec FR-012]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are backup/recovery requirements for production data specified, or explicitly out of
  scope? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "legitimately rejected" enumerated with the exact business rules that may reject an
  order submission? [Clarity, Spec SC-002]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the booking-conflict window defined with a measurable duration source? [Clarity,
  Spec FR-009]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the cancel grace window quantified with its configured value in requirements?
  [Clarity, Spec FR-010]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "hot path" enumerated (exact routes/flows the latency target applies to)?
  [Clarity, Spec SC-006]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the duplicate-submission fix bounded (smallest safe mechanism, no framework) so
  reviewers can tell scope creep? [Clarity, Spec FR-008b]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are mobile-usability requirements specified with testable criteria, or explicitly
  excluded? [Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 - Are lifecycle-transition requirements consistent between the order matrix, booking
  matrix, and the retired delivery path? [Consistency, Spec FR-003]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are totals/pricing requirements consistent between order submission, bookings, and the
  canonical platform price (no conflicting values)? [Consistency, Spec FR-002]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are tenant-isolation requirements consistent for owner, admin, staff, visitor, and
  retired delivery actors? [Consistency, Spec FR-001]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is "no online payments" consistently reflected (no payment terminology or flow in any
  requirement)? [Consistency, Spec D5]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 - Can the 50-submission burst criterion be objectively verified (successes vs legitimate
  rejections counted separately)? [Measurability, Spec SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the duplicate-submission criterion measurable independently of the burst test
  (single persisted order per intent)? [Measurability, Spec FR-008b]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are load thresholds (50 burst, 10/min, 95% within 2s) stated identically in every
  requirement that cites them? [Consistency, Spec SC-006]
- [ ] CHK020 - Can the cross-tenant probe criterion be objectively verified (100% denial, zero leaked
  records)? [Measurability, Spec SC-001]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are concurrent-submission and duplicate-submission scenarios specified as separate
  concerns with separate tests? [Coverage, Spec FR-008]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for subscription-expiry mid-session and reactivation without
  data repair? [Coverage, Spec FR-004]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are short-code enumeration/throttling requirements defined for tracking and offer
  lookups? [Coverage, Spec FR-007]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are live-update disconnect/reconnect consistency requirements specified? [Coverage,
  Spec FR-013]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are migration re-run (already-migrated database) requirements defined as a no-op?
  [Coverage, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 - Are rate-limiting requirements quantified per surface (global, login, order creation)?
  [Completeness, Spec FR-019]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are single-node ceilings (in-memory limits, live events) documented with their
  hardening path instead of silently assumed? [Completeness, Spec FR-019]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are upload requirements specified by type, size, content verification, and orphan
  prevention? [Completeness, Spec FR-006]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are secrets/environment-variable requirements specified (prod secret strength, no
  localhost DB, disposable-DB testing)? [Completeness, Spec FR-017]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are dependency requirements specified (no new services or frameworks, Wasmer
  compatibility)? [Completeness, Spec FR-020]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are notification-reliability requirements defined for order/booking events, or
  explicitly scoped to reconnect consistency only? [Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK032 - Is the live-deployment verification step specified before any serving-path change?
  [Dependency, Spec US5]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are legacy-removal requirements bounded (classify first, report before delete, never
  auto-delete docs/data/history)? [Completeness, Spec FR-014]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are test-environment requirements specified (disposable database, never production)?
  [Completeness, Spec FR-016]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Gaps found during review (CHK006, CHK012, CHK025, CHK031) need spec amendments or explicit
  out-of-scope decisions before implementation
- Cosmetic design intentionally excluded per request
